visualCharacteristics.structure: Row 1: 1 merged cell [h3 caption, p]; row 2: header cells; rows 3..n: data cells (first column bold)

contentPattern.structure: Row 1: 1 merged cell [h3 caption, p] rendered as a dark caption box; row 2: header cells (e.g. Rating | FICO Score | Description); rows 3..n: data cells, first column bold row label; light row dividers and outer border
